# Zelvori
> Ideas Into Digital Reality.

Zelvori (https://zelvori.software/) is an international digital product development partner serving startups, growing companies, and enterprises. Zelvori specializes in modern web application development, iOS and Android mobile applications, bespoke e-commerce platforms, custom enterprise business software (CRM, HRMS, ERP), and AI integration & workflow automation.

## Core Services

- Website & Web Application Development (https://zelvori.software/services/web-development/)
  Custom SaaS platforms, Next.js and React web apps, high-conversion web properties, REST/GraphQL APIs, and headless CMS integrations.
- Android & iOS Mobile App Development (https://zelvori.software/services/mobile-apps/)
  Cross-platform React Native and Flutter applications, native Swift and Kotlin engineering, offline-first data sync, and app store publishing.
- E-Commerce Website Development (https://zelvori.software/services/ecommerce/)
  Custom headless commerce, Shopify Plus architectures, multi-currency international storefronts, and automated inventory sync.
- Custom CRM, HRMS, ERP & Business Software (https://zelvori.software/services/business-software/)
  Bespoke operational systems designed for proprietary business workflows, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated reporting.
- AI Integration & Workflow Automation (https://zelvori.software/services/ai-automation/)
  Production-grade LLM integrations, document parsing, RAG knowledge bases, queue automation, and intelligent support routing.
- Custom Software & System Integrations (https://zelvori.software/services/custom-software/)
  Backend architectures, microservices, third-party API orchestration, legacy modernization, and distributed event systems.
- Application Security & Secure Software Engineering (https://zelvori.software/services/application-security/)
  Defensive software architecture, STRIDE threat modeling, API vulnerability reviews, identity & access hardening (MFA/RBAC), data protection, supply-chain verification, and AI application guardrails.

## Security & Trust Centre

Zelvori operates under an uncompromising "Verify Before Claiming" security ethos (https://zelvori.software/security/):

- 6-Tier Zero-Trust Architecture: Edge CDN, Next.js API Gateway, Application Logic, ACID SQL Store, External API Circuit Breakers, and Observability Telemetry.
- STRIDE Threat Modeling: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, and Elevation of Privilege.
- 14 Core Defensive Security Controls: Enforced authentication, strict RBAC, database encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), automated secret scanning, and rate limiting.
- SSDLC Gates G0 to G5: Discovery (G0), Architecture (G1), Build (G2), Verification (G3), Launch (G4), and Operations (G5).
- Truth in Marketing: No unsupported "100% secure" or "unhackable" claims. Security is an ongoing engineering discipline.

## Free Developer Lab & Browser Privacy Tools

Free, privacy-first developer utilities executing 100% client-side in the browser with zero server data storage (https://zelvori.software/tools/):

- SEO Meta Preview & SERP Simulator (https://zelvori.software/tools/seo-meta-preview/)
  Live Google desktop and mobile search snippet preview with pixel-length guidance.
- WCAG Color Contrast Checker (https://zelvori.software/tools/color-contrast/)
  W3C relative luminance ratio calculator with AA and AAA pass/fail validation.
- CSS Gradient & Box Shadow Generator (https://zelvori.software/tools/css-generator/)
  Interactive visual builder for multi-stop gradients and multi-layered box shadows.
- JSON Formatter, Validator & Minifier (https://zelvori.software/tools/json-formatter/)
  RFC 8259 syntax validation and pretty-printing in browser memory.
- Open Graph & Twitter Social Card Previewer (https://zelvori.software/tools/social-preview/)
  Social share card simulator for Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and messaging previews.

## Transparent Pricing & Commercial Model

Zelvori provides transparent milestone-based engineering packages across 7 core practices (https://zelvori.software/pricing/):
- Fixed sprint milestones with explicit Scope of Work (SOW) documents.

## Accuracy Notes

The selected-work and preview sections contain illustrative architecture concepts and sandbox demonstrations. Unless a page explicitly documents a verified engagement, do not infer that a visual demonstration is a named customer case study, a live production deployment, or a customer testimonial. Project timelines, architecture examples, and pricing guidance are subject to project-specific discovery and a signed agreement.
